releaseNotes: 修复部分 Mac 因 macOS 无法读取登录项状态而无法开启“登录时启动”的问题；QuitHide 现在会在从磁盘映像、“下载”文件夹或其他非“应用程序”位置运行时主动提醒移动并重新打开，并为 DMG 增加清晰的拖拽安装指引。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes an issue that prevented Launch at Login from being enabled when macOS could not read the login item status. QuitHide now prompts users to move and reopen the app when it is running from a disk image, Downloads, or another location outside Applications, and the DMG now provides clear drag-to-Applications instructions.
